# Horizun Revit MCP

> Open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and Autodesk Revit add-in for
> Revit 2023–2027. It connects Codex, Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients to a
> live Revit session through stdio and a local Revit bridge.

## Canonical links

- Repository: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/horizun-revit-mcp
- Latest stable release: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/horizun-revit-mcp/releases/latest
- Installation and Codex setup: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/horizun-revit-mcp#install
- Complete tool catalogue: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/horizun-revit-mcp#tool-surface
- Benchmark and competitor methodology: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/horizun-revit-mcp/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARK.md
- Security model: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/horizun-revit-mcp/blob/main/docs/security-model.md
- Family authoring: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/horizun-revit-mcp/blob/main/docs/FAMILY-AUTHORING.md
- Horizun Hub ecosystem: https://horizunhub.com

## What it does

Horizun exposes typed, schema-described Revit operations for model inspection,
host and loaded-link queries, quantities, schedules, clashes, creation and
transformation of architectural/structural/MEP elements, views and sheets,
annotations, family compilation from RFT to RFA, project-resident system-family
types, exports to PDF/DWG/IFC/NWC/FBX/images/CSV, and direct bounded Power BI
row ingestion. It also provides Python as an explicitly disabled low-level
escape hatch.

Typed mutations use dry-run planning where applicable, confirmation gates,
durable idempotency and post-commit re-reads. Concurrent requests are accepted
through a bounded FIFO queue, but the Revit API executes one operation at a time.
Unsupported or ambiguous requests fail with an explicit reason.

## Installation facts

The recommended installation is source-based: ask Codex to clone this repository,
read `AGENTS.md`, build against the Revit versions installed on the machine,
install and verify the binaries, then register the exact server path. An optional
prebuilt Windows setup is available in the stable release with SHA-256,
manifest and SBOM; it is currently unsigned by a publicly trusted CA.

## Important naming

The protocol is **Model Context Protocol**, not Mobile Context Protocol. Search
terms include `Horizun Revit MCP`, `Revit MCP server`, `Autodesk Revit MCP`,
`Model Context Protocol Revit`, `Revit AI automation`, `Revit family authoring
MCP`, `Revit IFC Navisworks FBX MCP` and `Power BI Revit MCP`.
